name: Margol's Gigantic Horn
summary: Margol’s Gigantic Horn is a battered trophy from Searing Gorge. Mountaineer Pebblebitty needs it before he will consider opening Stonewrought Pass.

sections.title: A Rough Trophy
sections.body: In Searing Gorge, Margol’s Gigantic Horn is a curious find for anyone seeking a way through Stonewrought Pass. Scratches and cracks mark its rough surface, and an unusual piece of metal is lodged in it. Mountaineer Pebblebitty is the one who wants to see the horn.

faq.answer: Mountaineer Pebblebitty wants to see Margol’s Gigantic Horn. He is at the pass between Loch Modan and Searing Gorge.

faq.q: Where can I find the horn?
faq.answer: Margol’s Gigantic Horn comes from Margol the Rager in Searing Gorge.

faq.q: Why does Pebblebitty need the horn?
faq.answer: Pebblebitty asks to see Margol’s Gigantic Horn before he will consider opening Stonewrought Pass between Loch Modan and Searing Gorge.

faq.q: What is lodged in the horn?
faq.answer: A broken axe head is lodged in the rough surface. Its metal bears the words “Property of Mountaineer Pebblebitty.”

faq.q: Why does Pebblebitty call it fake?
faq.answer: Pebblebitty insists the horn is too small to be Margol’s, claiming Margol’s horn is at least eight times larger.
